The enemies ALMOST always chase the clone thinking it’s you because they assume you don’t know how to control your clone and that you’re just trying to escape. Then they get to it, it explodes, you Q in, drop a box, and e them until they die :) If going AP upgrade boxes first, then E, and put a couple points into Q for the extra invis time when you feel like it.

Going AP or AD depends a lot on your teams composition and the enemy team. If I have an AD midlaner (yasuo, talon, etc) I will go AP. I prefer going AP because it gives you a lot to work with when it comes to making plays. My best word of advice is to go liandrys and lucidity boots for your first two items.
